title: National - Maintain the Network
current_summary: Urgent planned maintenance by an upstream access network provider is scheduled nationwide on Friday 14 August 2026 from 2:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEST. Some services may lose connectivity during the window, with a single interruption of up to 3 hours per service expected. Our team will monitor closely and work with network partners to minimise impact. No separate restoration time has been provided beyond the maintenance window.

updates.content: Planned maintenance is scheduled on the national access network on Friday 14 August 2026 from 2:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEST. During this window, some customers may experience a temporary loss of internet service. A single interruption of up to 3 hours may occur per service. Our team will monitor progress and work with our network partners to minimise impact and restore services as quickly as possible. If your connection does not return after the window, please restart your modem/router. Using mobile data where available can help you stay online during the work. Thank you for your patience.
